name: Congo Cash XL

features.name: Jewel board
features.description: Random jewels above the reels award cash and free spins.

review:
A six-reel jungle sequel with frogs, cheetahs and apes, plus diamond wilds on reels 2 to 6. A jewel board above reels 2 to 5 shows random jewels that tumble after every spin and can award free spins and cash.

Jewels are worth 4x to 200x, and a jackpot symbol pays up to 2,000x. Butterflies only land on reels one and six. The jewel board adds a second layer of action above the reels. 96.41% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
